痛点区标题.zh: 企业使用 AI，需要处理哪些问题？
痛点区标题.en: What does AI need to work in a business?

痛点 1.zh: 散在各个系统 —— 产品资料、业务记录和操作经验分布在不同文档与系统中。→ 接入并整理资料，建立按权限检索的索引。
痛点 1.en: Scattered sources — Product information, business records and procedures live in different documents and systems. → Connect and organize these sources for retrieval with access controls.

痛点 2.zh: 信息给不全 —— 一次请求能容纳的信息有限，过多无关资料也会干扰回答。→ Cyano Core 根据当前任务选择相关资料与上下文。
痛点 2.en: Incomplete context — Each request has a size limit, and irrelevant material can distract from the question. → Cyano Core selects sources and context for the current task.

痛点 3.zh: 缺少核对机制 —— 生成内容可能有误，合同和财务等工作需要明确的审核程序。→ 在流程中加入规则校验、来源引用和人工审核。
痛点 3.en: No way to verify — Generated content can be wrong, and work involving contracts or finances needs review. → Add validation rules, source citations and human approval to the workflow.

痛点 4.zh: 没形成团队能力 —— 员工各自编写提示词，处理方法和结果难以统一。→ 按企业 SOP 设置操作步骤，保留执行记录，供团队重复使用。
痛点 4.en: No shared practice — Individually written prompts can produce inconsistent processes and results. → Define shared steps from your SOPs and retain execution records.

Hero 标题.zh: 选择适合当前项目的合作方式
Hero 标题.en: Choose how to work with us

Hero 导语.zh: 先评估现有流程的成本、使用频率和预期收益，再确定开发范围与合作方式。三种模式的交付内容和维护责任如下。
Hero 导语.en: We assess current costs, usage and expected benefits before agreeing on scope. The three options below differ in what you receive and who operates the system.

怎么选.zh: 需要长期使用自有系统，可以选择定制开发；还不确定效果，可以先做试点；希望委托我们按批次完成工作，可以选择托管服务。
怎么选.en: Choose a custom build for a system your team will own and use regularly, a pilot to test an uncertain use case, or a managed service for work you want us to deliver in batches.

SaaS 托管.zh: 在隔离的云端环境中使用系统，按使用量扩展资源，适合试点和较轻的工作负载。
SaaS 托管.en: Use the system in an isolated cloud environment, with resources scaled to usage. Suitable for pilots and lighter workloads.

私有化部署.zh: 模型与数据在你的环境中运行。交付 Docker 部署配置，并适配本地算力；部署要求在项目开始前确认。
私有化部署.en: Run models and data inside your environment. We provide Docker deployment configurations and adapt them to local compute, with requirements agreed before the project starts.

应该完整定制，还是从试点开始？ / Full build or pilot fi.zh: 需求明确且使用频繁时，可以规划完整系统。对效果或使用量还没有把握时，先用小范围试点测试，再决定是否扩展。
应该完整定制，还是从试点开始？ / Full build or pilot fi.en: A full build suits clear requirements and frequent use. If results or likely usage remain uncertain, test a smaller scope in a pilot before expanding.

什么时候适合托管式 AI 服务？ / When does managed ser.zh: 适合希望按批次委托工作、暂不准备自行维护系统的团队。客户提供资料与标准，Cyano 运行 AI 工作流并审核结果。
什么时候适合托管式 AI 服务？ / When does managed ser.en: It suits teams that want to outsource recurring work without operating a system. You supply sources and criteria; Cyano runs the AI workflow and reviews the output.

需求评估会提供什么？ / What does the assessment pr.zh: 我们会梳理操作步骤、数据来源和参与人员，估算改造成本与预期收益，给出建议范围和实施顺序。
需求评估会提供什么？ / What does the assessment pr.en: We review the process, data sources and people involved, estimate costs and benefits, and recommend a scope and implementation sequence.

如何获得适合自己的方案？ / How do we get a tailored.zh: 联系我们后，我们会根据业务价值、技术复杂度、使用规模和上线节奏，给出贴合实际的建议与报价。
如何获得适合自己的方案？ / How do we get a tailored.en: Talk to us. We tailor the recommendation and quote to your business value, technical complexity, scale and timeline.

数据安全如何保障？ / How is our data protected?.zh: 支持私有化部署，数据不出你的环境；系统内置权限控制、全链路日志审计与敏感信息拦截。
数据安全如何保障？ / How is our data protected?.en: Private deployment keeps data inside your environment. Every system includes access control, full audit logs and sensitive-data filtering.

上线之后谁来维护？ / Who maintains it after launc.zh: 三种模式都包含上线后的维护。定制开发和试点的维护、迭代范围在合作时约定；托管服务的运行与交付由 Cyano 负责。
上线之后谁来维护？ / Who maintains it after launc.en: All three options include maintenance. The scope of support and further development is agreed for builds and pilots; Cyano operates and delivers the managed service.

如果效果不达预期怎么办？ / What if results fall shor.zh: 试点开始前，双方约定验收标准。根据实际结果判断需要补充资料、调整流程还是停止试点，再决定是否扩大投入。
如果效果不达预期怎么办？ / What if results fall shor.en: Agree on acceptance criteria before the pilot. Use the results to decide whether to improve the sources, change the workflow or stop before investing further.

Hero 标题.zh: 我们如何开发和维护企业 AI 系统
Hero 标题.en: How we build and maintain enterprise AI

Hero 导语.zh: 这里介绍资料检索、上下文管理和任务编排的处理方法，以及成本、响应速度、权限和部署的设计。
Hero 导语.en: Our approach covers retrieval, context management and task orchestration, along with cost, response time, access controls and deployment.

Cyano Core 定义.zh: Cyano Core 是我们用于项目开发的工程平台。它索引企业资料、按 SOP 执行任务，并记录输出所用的依据和处理步骤，供业务人员复核。
Cyano Core 定义.en: Cyano Core is the engineering platform we use in our projects. It indexes company sources, runs tasks according to SOPs and records the evidence and steps behind outputs for review.

第 1 层.zh: 知识摄入 —— 连接 PDF、数据库、API 等多源数据，建立带权限管理的动态索引。
第 1 层.en: Ingestion — Connects PDFs, databases and APIs into a permission-aware, continuously updated index.

第 2 层.zh: 上下文编排 —— 在有限的 Token 预算内，自动筛选并拼装最相关的信息。
第 2 层.en: Context orchestration — Selects and assembles only the most relevant information within the token budget.

第 3 层.zh: 任务执行 —— 将 SOP 配置为 Playbook，定义操作步骤、校验规则和异常处理方式。
第 3 层.en: Execution — Configure SOPs as playbooks with defined steps, validation rules and exception handling.

第 4 层.zh: 权限与审计 —— 记录处理日志、保留来源引用，并过滤敏感信息。
第 4 层.en: Access and audit — Record processing logs, retain source citations and filter sensitive information.

难题 1.zh: 调用成本 —— 每次发送完整历史记录，会使长对话的 API 费用持续增加。
难题 1.en: API costs — Resending the full history increases costs as a conversation grows.

难题 2.zh: 响应等待 —— 输入内容越长，模型开始返回文字前的处理时间可能越久。
难题 2.en: Response time — Longer inputs can increase the wait before the model begins responding.

难题 3.zh: 指令遗漏 —— 资料过多时，模型可能忽略夹在中间的重要指令。
难题 3.en: Missed instructions — A model may overlook important instructions within a large body of material.

估值引擎标题.zh: 根据任务选择上下文，控制长对话的成本与延迟。
估值引擎标题.en: Select context for each task to control cost and latency in long conversations.

指标 1.zh: < 200ms* —— 响应延迟，第 1 轮与第 100 轮一样快
指标 1.en: < 200ms* — response latency, as fast at turn 100 as at turn 1

指标 3.zh: 最多 40%* —— Token 成本降低

指标 4.zh: 最高 10 倍* —— 投入回报

对比表标题.zh: 统一管理知识、流程与模型接入
对比表标题.en: Manage knowledge, workflows and model access

对比表行.zh: 知识来源：员工手动提供 → 按权限检索企业知识库；执行过程：手动编写提示词 → 按 SOP 执行并记录步骤；模型接入：分别调用 → 通过统一接口接入；模型更换：逐项调整 → 保留知识与流程，测试新模型后切换
对比表行.en: Sources: manually supplied → retrieved from authorized company knowledge; Execution: manually written prompts → recorded SOP steps; Model access: separate calls → a shared interface; Model changes: individual adjustments → retain knowledge and workflows, test before switching

收尾.en: Talk to our CTO about your data and deployment requirements.

使命句.zh: 让企业知识流动起来，变成每天在用的 AI 系统
使命句.en: We make company knowledge flow into AI systems your team uses every day

我们是谁 1.zh: Cyano（澜屿智创）是一支企业 AI 工程团队，服务中国与北美的企业客户。我们为企业定制 AI 工具、AI 工作流与托管式 AI 服务，专注于把 AI 用进销售、文档、知识管理和数据分析等核心业务流程。
我们是谁 1.en: Cyano is an enterprise AI engineering team serving clients in China and North America. We build custom AI tools, workflows and managed AI services that put AI to work in sales, documents, knowledge management and analytics.

我们是谁 2.zh: 每位核心成员都有 6 年以上开发经验，参与过 AI 模型研发，并曾在世界 500 强企业工作。团队共同负责项目的需求分析、开发和上线维护。
我们是谁 2.en: Every core member has more than six years of development experience, has worked on AI model R&D and has worked at a Fortune Global 500 company. The team handles requirements, development and post-launch maintenance.

名字的由来正文.zh: Cyano（澜屿智创）提供企业 AI 定制开发、试点与托管服务。我们根据企业的资料和流程设计系统，并负责约定范围内的上线维护。
名字的由来正文.en: Cyano provides custom enterprise AI development, pilots and managed services. We design systems around company sources and workflows, and maintain them within the agreed service scope.

团队数字.zh: 6+ 年：每位核心成员的最低开发经验 · 100%：核心成员拥有 AI 模型研发经验 · 100%：核心成员拥有世界 500 强企业工作经历 · 6 个：已服务行业
团队数字.en: 6+ years: minimum engineering experience per core member · 100%: hands-on AI model R&D · 100%: Fortune Global 500 experience · 6: industries in production

原则 1.zh: 评估投入与收益 —— 开发前核对工作量、资料条件和预期改善，确定是否值得投入。
原则 1.en: Assess costs and benefits — Review workload, source quality and expected improvements before committing to development.

原则 2.zh: 约定验收标准 —— 在项目开始前明确系统要完成的任务、审核方式与上线条件。
原则 2.en: Agree on acceptance criteria — Define the tasks, review process and launch requirements before development.

原则 3.zh: 保留回答依据 —— 使用企业提供的资料，并将关键结论与来源关联，方便核查。
原则 3.en: Keep source references — Use company material and link key statements to their sources for review.

原则 4.zh: 安排后续维护 —— 根据资料、业务规则和模型变化更新系统，持续处理使用反馈。
原则 4.en: Plan for maintenance — Update the system as sources, business rules and models change, and address user feedback.

Hero 导语.zh: 告诉我们目前如何完成这项工作、需要多少时间，以及希望改进什么。有现成的工作样本即可开始讨论，不必先写完整的需求文档。
Hero 导语.en: Tell us how you do the work today, how long it takes and what you want to improve. A work sample is enough to begin; a full requirements document can come later.

起点 1.zh: 评估业务需求 —— 一起梳理目标、操作步骤、数据条件和成本，判断适合定制、试点还是托管。
起点 1.en: Assess your needs — review goals, process, data and costs to choose between a custom build, pilot or managed service.

起点 2.zh: 了解已有项目 —— 可安排与你业务相近的案例演示，完整系统演示需签署保密协议。
起点 2.en: See related projects — arrange a demo relevant to your business. Full system walkthroughs require an NDA.

起点 3.zh: 确认技术与部署 —— 数据接入、权限、私有化部署、模型选择和后续维护，都可以先聊。
